//css-class-collision: Two (.field in atlas/decide, .cluster in workbench/index), inherited from basecamp with the move.
//gate-unreachable: One: the three Claude models keep @@gate(5.8) and the one Member's session grades ADMINISTRATOR by `isAdmin` in api/src/auth.ts. The rule reads an isAdmin column or a getLevel resolver and cannot see a session field, so the finding is the rule's blind spot, not a wall.
//package-model-drift: One: db/schema.lite's Notification.userId is Int with a relation to Member, where @frontierjs/notifications' fragment says String for auth's uuid ids. Workbench has no auth package and Member.id is Int; the drift is the one column, on purpose (IDEAS/workbench-package.md 3.2).
//polymorphic-subject: One: Notification.subjectType is the fragment's bare String; the one kind Workbench sends (AutopilotReport) has no subject row to point at.
//service-as-system: One: api/src/domain/job/job-context.ts runs a job as the app through asSystem(). Workbench has one Member and no tenancy, so there is no other user's row to cross; the job runs as the machine's owner.
